TestScyllaManagerSuspension::test_create.description: Creates a 2-node cluster, adds it to Scylla Manager, runs `sctool suspend`, then tries `sctool repair` (immediate task). Asserts the command fails with an error containing both "suspended" and "scheduling tasks is not allowed" (SM's shouldPutTask rejection of new tasks on a suspended cluster). Guards the Manager rule that no task can be created while the cluster is suspended (originally scylla-manager-enterprise#2496, where creation unexpectedly succeeded and the task stuck in NEW).

TestScyllaManagerSuspension::test_schedu.description: Creates a 3-node cluster, adds it to Manager and creates a repair task with a cron firing at the next minute boundary (20-80s ahead, cron_for_next_minute, dtest_scylla_manager.py:2005), then suspends and asserts the fire time has not passed yet. Sleeps until fire time + 10s and asserts the task status is still NEW, then resumes (`sctool resume --start-tasks`) and asserts the task has no run history and is still NEW. Guards that scheduled activations are not executed while suspended and that a missed activation is not run on resume.
